I couldn't confirm OPS-5140, and I've told Pree that in a thread reply to her message in #central-team.

- **Shared files:** there are no Quarrendon Freight Lines files that I can see. In fact, the accounts folder returned nothing at all.
- **#central-team history:** nobody had mentioned OPS-5140 or a gate kiosk outage before her message.

So I treated the number as an unconfirmed lead, not a fact. I suggested that someone with access to the support queue look it up before anyone quotes it to the customer or puts it in the tracker. I also pointed out that in July 2025 someone in the channel wrote "Quarendon Freightways," so the customer's name is worth checking along with the ticket.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read any other channels.
